title: Evaluating BERTopic on Open-Ended Data: A Case Study with Belgian Dutch Daily Narratives

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the performance of different topic modeling algorithms (KMeans, LDA, BERTopic) on a corpus of Flemish (Belgian Dutch) daily narratives using automated coherence metrics and a human-evaluated word intrusion task to demonstrate how standard models and metrics overlook the nuances of underrepresented regional dialects and linguistic communities.

Assessing the ability of topic models to identify culturally resonant and specific themes within a localized Belgian context through qualitative analysis and human evaluation, contrasting contextual embeddings against traditional bag-of-words approaches.
